As a Reachtruck driver you report to the team management of the IPL department. You work an average of 38 hours a week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 hours and the second starts at 15:15 hours. The end times are flexible. Sometimes you work on Saturdays. On that day there is only a morning shift. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as a Reachtruck driver at Action.  Functievereisten  - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech. Basic English is required - Approachable and accurate - You want to work for a longer period of time - Experience in working with a reachtruck is an advantage - Reachtruck certificate  Arbeidsvoorwaarden  - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - Organized transport to work - Weekly payments - During the afternoon shift you get a free evening meal - Opportunity to earn a performance bonus - Additional allowances: 125% between 20:00 and 24:00, and 150% between 00:00 and 06:00
